'''[[R2z-DL]]'s operative''' was a deep-cover agent for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He was assassinated under orders from the [[Laboi]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Qa'till]].
